positions.title: Database Systems Intern
positions.description:
Facilitated UI improvements by gathering user feedback and working with developers to optimize database queries and front-end components, reducing load times by 20% for USAID’s OTI Anywhere platform, enhancing efficiency for over 9,000 employees.

Contributed to the implementation of 15 new features by relaying stakeholder inputs to development teams, leading to a 30% increase in user satisfaction and revising documentation to help new employees navigate the platform.

Led quality assurance efforts by testing and documenting issues, providing actionable feedback that resolved over 50 critical bugs, reducing system crashes by 25%, and improving platform stability for over 1,000 daily users.

positions.title: Vice President External Affairs
positions.description:
Represented CougarCS to external partners, acting as the primary point of contact for student organizations, alumni, and university partners to foster collaboration and strengthen community ties.

Managed and maintained 15 relationships with other student organizations at the University of Houston, facilitating cross-organizational events and initiatives to increase engagement.

Raised over $10,000 for CodeRed by serving as the key point of contact for approvals and sponsorships, securing funds to support student participation in hackathons and other educational events, which enhanced the club’s visibility and opportunities for its members.
positions.insights: Skills: Marketing · Public Relations · Public Affairs

positions.title: Marketing Director
positions.description:
Introduced new marketing techniques using personal networking and targeted outreach, driving attendance to 200+ participants for the first in-person CodeRED event post-pandemic.

Marketed the event consistently on and off-campus, leveraging social media platforms and in-person interactions to maximize visibility and engagement.

Supervised a team of 24 officers, providing guidance, feedback, and support to ensure the successful execution of marketing strategies and event promotion.

projects.title: Safety Forms
projects.description:
Our web app hosts two main capabilities..
First, it has a Feedback Area, where Staff Members can submit requests and concerns – namely, Physical Concerns, Mental Concerns, Hazard Report, Diversity Suggestion, Resource Submission, and Miscellaneous Concerns – directly to Administrators.
Administrators can see these submissions directly within our app.
The second capability our app has is a Community Resources Page. It allows for easy access to important safety content, and staff and administrators can easily add resources to this page.
